_comment: The list of companies to watch. Edit this file to add or remove companies.
'cik' is the SEC's permanent numeric ID for a filer (Central Index Key).
You can look one up at https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany
or search the full list at https://www.sec.gov/files/company_tickers.json
Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the script.
